functions.name: GRID
functions.description: Live grid data for an ISO or grid code from DC Hub (dchub.cloud).

parameters.name: iso
parameters.description: Grid code, e.g. PJM, ERCOT, CAISO

functions.name: DCPI
functions.description: DCPI power verdict for a data center market from DC Hub (dchub.cloud), CC BY 4.0.

parameters.name: field
parameters.description: Field to return (default verdict; e.g. composite_score)

functions.name: FACILITIES
functions.description: Data center facilities matching a search, as a table, from DC Hub (dchub.cloud).

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Free text, e.g. Ashburn or an operator name

functions.name: ENERGY_RATE
functions.description: Retail electricity rate for a US state from DC Hub (dchub.cloud), sourced from EIA.
